## Type of change

<!-- Mark the relevant option with [x]. -->

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix resolving an incorrect diagnostic or crash (non-breaking patch per [versioning policy](packages/eslint-config-yarapa/README.md#versioning-policy))
- [ ] `feat`: New rule or increased severity (breaking change per [versioning policy](packages/eslint-config-yarapa/README.md#versioning-policy))
- [ ] `feat`: Rule relaxation or backward-compatible capability (non-breaking minor per [versioning policy](packages/eslint-config-yarapa/README.md#versioning-policy))
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation, README, or rule guide update
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal code or test refactoring without diagnostic changes
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, CI, or dependency updates
